tasks.short: Signal coworkers to synchronize material flow

steps.what: Observe actual roasting, baking or drying material flow and choose/check the exact coworker signal and recipient
steps.actor: food roasting baking drying machine operator
inputs: actual material flow and equipment readiness
actual coworker location and agreed signalling convention
outputs: operator-checked exact material-flow signal and intended coworker

steps.what: Signal coworkers to synchronize flow of materials using the checked exact signal directed to the intended coworker
steps.actor: food roasting baking drying machine operator
inputs: operator-checked exact material-flow signal and intended coworker
steps.approver: food roasting baking drying machine operator

steps.what: Check the actual coworker acknowledgement and material flow response before continuing the coordinated work
steps.actor: food roasting baking drying machine operator
inputs: actual coworker acknowledgement and material movement
outputs: operator-observed actual synchronisation or need for a new signal

tasks.design: Retain the operator's actual flow observation, exact signal selection, coworker signal and acknowledgement check. A {OPS_SYSTEM} message would need real current readiness and recipient context that this live hand-signal episode supplies through observation; no new sensor feed or signal log is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The signal depends on actual readiness and coworker response.
tasks.enabler_now: No specific native configuration changes the live observation and signalling work in this scenario.
tasks.still_hard: A stale or misunderstood signal can disrupt actual material flow.
tasks.human_edge: Notice that the coworker has not understood or that readiness changed before signalling.

ambition.what: No automatic material-flow control or unattended coordination.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0; no new system or control interface

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live production signalling requires current observation, a clear intended signal and acknowledgement.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional operator effort in actual live signalling, not a measured baseline or prompt prior.
The operator observes real flow/readiness and selects the exact agreed signal in s1; no structured readiness table or free data capture is assumed.
Native messages/templates were considered. The actual send is separate and fully retained, and this episode has no required record write or report to automate.
s1 checks the actual signal/recipient immediately before s2. Changed readiness requires a fresh selection/check, not reuse of a stale gate.
Gross/net saving and incremental upkeep are zero because all actual work remains and no system change is proposed.
unknowns: Actual signalling means and any maintained readiness feed
research_questions: Is there a real maintained machine-readiness interface that could change a specific operator step without adding capture work?

approvals.approved_version: operator-checked exact material-flow signal and intended coworker
approvals.approver: food roasting baking drying machine operator

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All actual observation, coworker signalling and acknowledgement remain; no hidden record or free readiness feed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read work orders for product quantities and types

steps.what: Find the actual current work order for the roasting, baking or drying equipment and production run
steps.actor: food roasting baking drying machine operator
inputs: actual production run and equipment identity

steps.what: Read work orders to determine quantities and types of products to be baked, dried or roasted
steps.actor: food roasting baking drying machine operator
inputs: actual work-order product, quantity and unit fields
outputs: operator-read actual product types, quantities and units

steps.what: Resolve actual work-order ambiguities or discrepancies and establish the required product/quantity understanding for the run
steps.actor: food roasting baking drying machine operator
inputs: operator-read actual product types, quantities and units
actual production constraints and supervisor clarification where needed
outputs: operator's clarified actual product and quantity requirements

tasks.design: Configure the native equipment/run/current-version work-order view in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the production execution application. The operator still reads actual product types and quantities and resolves ambiguities; no production record, machine setting or run-release action is added to this work-order reading task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation to the correct released work order can interrupt reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Native equipment/run filters can expose the actual current order.
tasks.still_hard: Units, changed orders and inconsistent instructions require actual interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when a nominally current order does not fit the intended run.

ambition.what: No automatic recipe choice, equipment setting or production release.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for actual released work-order and equipment views

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native equipment/run filters can reduce work-order navigation while actual product and quantity reading remains operator work.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional actual work-order reading, not measured run administration.
Production planning supplies actual released order ID/version, equipment/run, product, quantity and units. The operator checks actual matching and resolves missing/conflicting fields in s1/s3.
Only navigation changes; existing equivalent filters remove the gain. No free structured clarification outcome or automatic order interpretation is assumed.
Gross provisional saving 1.5 minus 0.5 hour of current-order-view upkeep gives 1 net. All actual reading and clarification remain counted.
This task ends with understanding actual requirements; no save, report, send or equipment commit is performed by the proposed change.
unknowns: Actual work-order navigation and version quality
research_questions: Does native equipment/run filtering remove repeated lookup without hiding revised instructions?

already_counted.description: Select and inspect the actual current work order

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1%; actual work-order reading and clarification remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
